training_use_boundary.note: These are adversarial family blueprints for generator/gate regression and later family-disjoint hard-negative materialization. They are not positive D/E labels and are not canonical dataset rows.

families.target_failure: same event_id reused with changed immutable event payload
families.split_law: All paired mutations for one causal family stay in one split; no mutated sibling may cross train/validation/holdout.
families.successor_requirement: Persist/verify canonical event_digest before replay idempotence is granted.

families.target_failure: caller-controlled independence_qualified creates independent evidence credit
families.successor_requirement: Remove naked caller boolean from authority; derive or verify a source-bound dependence certificate/event registry and bind its digest into the gate.

families.target_failure: task-local resolution after a formally registered but inadmissible/unexecuted discriminator
families.successor_requirement: Bind explicit admissibility/execution/coverage semantics or an equally strong closed-world law into the reference root and resolution receipt.

families.target_failure: COUNTERS versus FALSIFIES encoded as a generic mismatch_effect label rather than derived from claim/test semantics
families.successor_requirement: Prefer typed decisive_for_claim/test semantics and mechanically derive relation; if mismatch_effect remains, treat it as formal proof ontology and mutation-test it.

families.target_failure: UNKNOWN/HYPOTHESIS/PREDICTION promoted to OBSERVED by naked evidence_qualified_observation boolean
families.successor_requirement: Bind E/GRF promotion to typed evidence/proof receipt; preserve UNKNOWN != ZERO != ABSENT != FAILURE and MEASUREMENT_ERROR != ABSENCE.

nuisance_and_split_requirements: Branch IDs, branch order, presentation order, file/worker packaging and audit hashes remain evaluator-only nuisances.
All mutation siblings and causal/provenance ancestry siblings remain in the same dataset split.
No family becomes positive supervision until its reference successor deterministically computes the target and the model-visible nuisance audit passes.
Binding-router v3 remains separately quarantined for conditional nuisance leakage and cannot be used as a shortcut-bearing carrier for these families.
next_exact_action: Harden the retained v3/gate chain against these families, execute exact-source mutation tests, then regenerate only the families whose reference target is mechanically closed.
